columns.comment: Date the forecast was run: 30-Sep-2026 for the forward forecasts (Is Latest Forecast), the 1st of the month before the target month for the backtests. Measures return the latest run of the selection.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the forecast run as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the forecast run, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the forecast run).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: 7D (1-7 Oct 2026), 30D (October 2026 / the target month) or 90D (Oct-Dec 2026). Always filter or group by one Horizon - forecasts of different horizons must not be added.
columns.name: Horizon

columns.comment: Forecast model - v1 (MAPE about 18%, until the May-2026 targets) or v2 (upgraded model, about 11%, from June-2026; the forward runs).
columns.name: Model Version

columns.comment: Forward (from the as-of date 30-Sep-2026) or Backtest (historical one-month-ahead run scored against actuals).
columns.name: Forecast Type

columns.comment: True for the latest run (the forward forecasts dated 30-Sep-2026) - use it for "next 7 / 30 / 90 days" questions.
columns.name: Is Latest Forecast

columns.comment: Last day of the forecast window (e.g. 31-Oct-2026 for the 30D forward forecast).
columns.name: Window End

columns.comment: True when the forecast net cash flow over the window is negative (outflows exceed inflows).
columns.name: Is Forecast Net Negative

columns.comment: True when the forecast net outflow is at least 50% of the client's typical gross monthly flow (the liquidity-event engine's predicted-shortfall rule) - a liquidity need worth an RCF / overdraft conversation.
columns.name: Is Material Shortfall

columns.comment: True when the client has a committed RCF (with a balance at the month-end before the window).
columns.name: Has RCF

columns.comment: Client's coverage office / booking location (ISO-2).
columns.name: Booking Country

columns.comment: Forecast inflows (collections) over the forecast window, USD - latest run of the selection; one Horizon.
columns.name: Forecast Inflow USD

columns.comment: Expected outflows over the window (average monthly outflows of the 3 months before the run), USD.
columns.name: Forecast Outflow USD

columns.comment: Forecast inflows - expected outflows over the window, USD (negative = predicted net outflow).
columns.name: Forecast Net USD

columns.comment: Pessimistic (10th percentile) net cash flow = P10 inflows - expected outflows, USD (summed over clients = conservative).
columns.name: Forecast Net P10 USD

columns.comment: Optimistic (90th percentile) net cash flow = P90 inflows - expected outflows, USD.
columns.name: Forecast Net P90 USD

columns.comment: P10 forecast inflows (empirical 10th percentile of actual / forecast in the model's backtests), USD.
columns.name: Forecast Inflow P10 USD

columns.comment: P90 forecast inflows, USD.
columns.name: Forecast Inflow P90 USD

columns.comment: Undrawn committed RCF headroom (limit - drawn) at the month-end before the window, USD (30-Sep-2026 for the latest forecasts).
columns.name: Undrawn RCF USD

columns.comment: Clients' total deposits at the month-end before the window, USD.
columns.name: Opening Deposits USD

columns.comment: Opening deposits + forecast net cash flow, USD - the position at the end of the window if nothing else changes.
columns.name: Projected Closing Deposits USD

columns.comment: Legal entities with a forecast in the latest run of the selection.
columns.name: Clients Forecast

columns.comment: Legal entities whose forecast net cash flow over the window is negative (latest run; one Horizon).
columns.name: Clients Forecast Negative

columns.comment: Legal entities whose forecast net outflow is at least 50% of their typical gross monthly flow (latest run; one Horizon).
columns.name: Clients with Material Shortfall

columns.comment: Clients forecast net negative / clients forecast (fraction).
columns.name: Share of Clients Forecast Negative %

comment: Client cash-flow forecasts: the latest forward forecasts from 30-Sep-2026 for the next 7, 30 and 90 days (model v2; forecast inflows, expected outflows, net cash flow with P10 / P90) and the monthly backtest runs (30-day horizon, model v1 until the May-2026 targets, v2 from June-2026), with clients forecast to run a net outflow, material shortfalls and the undrawn committed RCF headroom to cover them. Each measure returns the LATEST forecast run in the selection - never a sum over runs - and must be read for ONE Horizon (filter Horizon = '30D', or group by Horizon); for "next 30 days" filter Is Latest Forecast and Horizon = '30D'. P10 / P90 summed over clients are conservative. Grain: one row per client x forecast date x horizon x model version (gold.fact_cashflow_forecast).
